column4: (3) A  termination  statement  effectively  terminates  the

column3: interest  of  a  secured  party  on  the  notice,  only  if  the
termination statement is authorized in writing by that secured
party. Upon the filing of an effective termination statement,
the  notice  to  which  the  termination  statement  relates
becomes ineffective with respect to the authorizing of the
secured party.

column4: (1) The  Credit  Information  Bureau  of  Sri  Lanka

column3: shall  cause  the  registration  of  any  notice,  an  amendment,
continuation statement or termination statement.

column4: (2) The registration with the Credit Information Bureau

column3: of Sri Lanka shall provide the final and conclusive evidence
regarding availability or non-availability of a mortgage in
respect of a collateral.

column4: (3) Where the Credit Information Bureau of Sri Lanka

column3: refuses  to  register  any  notice,  amendment,  continuation
statement  or  termination  statement,  it  shall  communicate
the  reasons  in  writing  to  the  person  who  applies  for  such
registration.

column4: (4) A notice authorized by one secured party on the notice

column3: and filed of record shall not affect the rights of another party.

column4: (5) Any person who notifies that the notice filed of record

column3: contains  erroneous  information,  he  shall  file  a  document
rectifying such error forthwith.

column4: (1)  It  shall  be  the  duty  of  the  Credit  Information

column3: Bureau  of  Sri  Lanka  to  furnish  prescribed  information  to
any person in relation to any notice filed therein.

column4: (2) The Credit Information Bureau of Sri Lanka may issue

column3: a Certificate in the prescribed form containing the required
information and maintain documents in the manner specified
in the rules.
